props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false`/`""` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Override the ambient resource (reserved for label i18n; inert in V1).

props.name: field
props.comment: A field component to render (given `source` + `empty`) instead of TextField.

props.name: variant
props.comment: 'inline' lays the label + value in a row; 'default' stacks them.

slots.name: default
slots.comment: Receives the resolved record; renders children or derived content.
